requirements.title: Machine-checkable artifact contract
requirements.statement: Every inventoried product must provide parseable, versioned, traceable design artifacts and required metadata without relying on a historical baseline waiver.
acceptance_criteria: The product is present exactly once in the committed inventory.
Required artifacts parse and conform to their declared schemas.
Every reported input is bound to a SHA-256 digest.

requirements.title: Executable sanity checks
requirements.statement: Every applicable design or model must parse, compile, elaborate, or execute with finite values and an available declared tool capability.
acceptance_criteria: Required tools and versions are recorded.
Missing tools or models are BLOCKED rather than passed.
Successful checks contain direct evidence from the executed artifact.

requirements.title: Engineering invariants
requirements.statement: Every product must satisfy its applicable structural, arithmetic, connectivity, geometry, interface, model, and cross-domain invariants.
acceptance_criteria: BOM arithmetic and reference identities reconcile.
CAD, netlist, board, and declared system relationships agree where applicable.
Every invariant links to evidence and a stable check identifier.

requirements.title: Traceable golden/reference agreement
requirements.statement: Every applicable model must reproduce a reviewed reference case using declared solver settings, provenance, metrics, and tolerances.
acceptance_criteria: The reference identity and provenance are recorded.
The deterministic adapter executes and emits finite metrics.
Every metric falls within its reviewed tolerance.

requirements.title: Reviewed corner coverage
requirements.statement: Every product must execute its applicable reviewed boundary, load, timing, fault, and environmental cases with deterministic settings.
acceptance_criteria: Corner definitions identify their requirement and provenance.
Seeds, timesteps, solver settings, and limits are recorded where applicable.
Every required measured metric remains within the declared bounds.
